## Mechanism

Describe the behavior, changed invariant, and why the boundary is coherent.

## Evidence

- [ ] `make build test-all format-check lint typecheck`
- [ ] New behavior has positive, negative, and roundtrip/golden coverage where applicable.
- [ ] Metrics are executed synthetic measurements and fictional/simulated labels are explicit.
- [ ] Persisted schema changes include version/migration and changelog updates.
- [ ] No keys, endpoints, external datasets, model weights, or build artifacts are included.
